**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

I read the full head `8f3c42407`, trial-merged it with main `6866890b6` (clean), and built and tested it locally in a fresh worktree. The change does what the issue #3450 asks: an AC1015 file with `CLASSES`, `THUMBNAILIMAGE`, `ACDSDATA` and layout objects now imports, and a damaged file still refuses with a named diagnostic.

### What looks good
- The skip of `CLASSES`/`THUMBNAILIMAGE`/`ACDSDATA` reads to the matching `ENDSEC` and gives `"<SECTION>: missing ENDSEC"` when the section is cut short or a `SECTION`/`EOF` arrives first (`crates/geometry/src/dxf/reader.rs:84`).
- A drawable record in a skipped place is refused, not dropped (`reader.rs:97` and `crates/geometry/src/dxf/dictionaries.rs:80`). This closes the silent-geometry-loss gap of the first revision.
- The group 102 bracket reader rejects nesting, an unopened close and an unclosed bracket with named errors (`dictionaries.rs:18`).
- Inert objects still join the #3176 ownership graph: handle, owner, duplicate handle and count limit are all checked (`dictionaries.rs:104`, `dictionaries.rs:130`).
- The #3176 pins in `dxf_inert_sections.rs` pass with no change.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in changed non-test code. No file over 400 lines (largest is `dictionaries.rs`, 219). New tests sit in `crates/geometry/tests/` and their gate maps name `camcraft_geometry`. No process files and no new dependency. Body has a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #3450`; all four commits are `fix(geometry): ...`.

### Results merged with main (`6866890b6`), built locally
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-geometry` `--no-run` build | ok |
| `dxf_ac1015_fixture` | 4 passed |
| `dxf_classes_section` | 8 passed |
| `dxf_objects_section` | 5 passed |
| `dxf_inert_sections` | 4 passed |
| `dxf` | 17 passed |
| `dxf_profile` | 5 passed |
| `dxf_refusals` | 15 passed |
| `sketch_data` | 9 passed |
| `camcraft-app` `contour_dxf_sketch` | 4 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The pinned tests are real pins: the AC1015 fixture is compared against an R12 twin with equal areas, every prefix before `EOF` is refused, and a 2000-case mutation loop asserts no panic.

### Targeted tests (step 5)
- No post or toolpath change: the example catalog is not reached.
- Light lane `cargo xtask gate light`: 3 steps, 0 failed (`light build`, `motion light: lib`, `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel`).
- Heavy step: none. This is `P3`, below `P1`, so no targeted heavy step is required.

### Requested before merge
None. I found no blocker.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `ENTITY_KINDS` (`crates/geometry/src/dxf/entities.rs:11`) is described as the ENTITIES chapter list, but a few names are absent: `SUN`, `MPOLYGON`, and the 3D surface subtypes (`EXTRUDEDSURFACE`, `LOFTEDSURFACE`, `NURBSURFACE`, `PLANESURFACE`, `REVOLVEDSURFACE`, `SWEPTSURFACE`). A damaged file could still place one of these in `CLASSES` and lose it with no diagnostic. This is not a regression, because the whole section was skipped before, and the 2D importer cannot draw those. Adding them would make the Part-3 refusal complete.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
